# tests/fixtures/r544/candidate_package

Frozen R544 fixture tree: real package_compiler output (vendored from a fresh R541 scenario-a battery ZIP), normalized to stable placeholder tokens (RUNID, CANDIDATE_ID, DISPOSITION). The fixture helper copies the tree per test, stamps the test's own identity values, refreshes PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json hashes, and rezips. Bytes other than the placeholders are genuine compiler output — the content/quality checks run against real artifact shapes, never hand-shaped JSON.
